items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: And he would play with us but when we played a specialty like 'Rhapsody in Blue'

ctx.x: Yes. And he would play with us but when we played a specialty like 'Rhapsody in Blue', you see Teddy was working three or four clubs in one night. He'd play 45 minutes here. Leave here and go across town, 45 minutes there. Leave there and go another place. And he was playing four clubs twice a night.
Well how do you rate him as a piano player as compared with somebody like Fats Waller or (Earl?).
